staff.goal: Request the correct documents for this guest type and refuse rental if originals are missing.

answerKey.staffSummary: Free additional-driver registration; unregistered = not insured; collect license docs for each driver.

staff.secret: Rental includes comprehensive insurance: bodily injury unlimited/person; property unlimited/accident; vehicle full amount/accident; personal injury up to ¥30 million/person. NOC peace-of-mind plan: would-be ¥20,000 (drivable) / ¥50,000 (tow); all customers enrolled; no self-pay when it applies. Exclusions still apply (e.g. no police report, unregistered driver).

answerKey.staffSummary: Insurance included with stated limits; NOC 安心プラン included (¥20k/¥50k would-be amounts); exclusions still matter. Korean Premium NOC extras: label as Korean-site unless manager confirms.

staff.secret: Return with a full tank of regular gasoline (レギュラー). Nearby stations on the official map include Carenex 名嘉地 (closed Tue, self-service), PB 伊良波 (closed Sun, cash only), Carenex かねひで上田 (year-round), Carenex ファミリーSS (closed Sun). Other nearby stations OK.

staff.secret: After return, free shuttle 08:00–18:00 about every 15 minutes (or 15–20) to Naha Airport or Akamine Station. Kokusai-dori course only twice daily: 15:30 and 17:00.
